name: Porphyritic-Cirque
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past impact-scarred wastelands, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
There is money in solar potential here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
